Laguna Colorada: pink flamingos against red water and the arid Andes

From Lima and the terraces of Machu Picchu, the route takes you to the islands of Lake Titicaca, the white expanse of the Uyuni Salt Flat and the lakes of the southern Altiplano. You will visit Uros and Taquile, cross the Bolivian side of Lake Titicaca by speedboat and travel via Ojo de Perdiz to the red and green lagoons of the Eduardo Avaroa Reserve.

## Guiding and flights

An English-speaking guide accompanies the excursions in the itinerary except for the Lake Titicaca crossing and the Uyuni portion. The language of assistance for these portions is confirmed at booking.

The included flights are Lima to Cusco and La Paz to Uyuni and back to La Paz. The La Paz to Lima flight appears in the daily itinerary and is paid for separately.
